.claude/docs/services/escher-driver.md: - The command line, through the real `escher-session` binary (seven_guis, unix only): `host_binary` (the host role on `counter`; a host that cannot serve; nine argv rows that are no command), `host_log` (a host on `crud` at `RUST_LOG=trace` while seven calls run, one `lint` and one `snapshot` part read among them: one span line per call, no id, name or typed text, under both builds;
